Hi Julie — great to hear you enjoyed the demo. Attaching our standard Privacy Addendum (Redwood_Privacy_Addendum_v1.pdf) and a current subprocessor inventory. Quick notes up front: we support execution via DocuSign (preferred) or AdobeSign if you require it, and for EU→US transfers we rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and a set of technical/organizational measures. We also offer an opt-in EU region deployment for customers who want data residency in eu-west-1 for production.

I've looped in Lauren (legal) and Karthik (sales ops) to confirm any commercial redlines or exceptions. Please feel free to mark up the docx redline and return.

Next steps I propose:
1) Lauren confirms the fallback language for subprocessors and SCCs.
2) We accept editable redlines by EOD Thursday if possible.
3) We send a DocuSign packet after agreed redlines for signature.

Hi Maya / Julie — thanks for the redlines and the clarity. Quick responses inline: 
- Subprocessors: I've attached an expanded inventory with vendor roles and data centers (Redwood_Subprocessors_Detail_20260617.pdf). That lists hosting (CloudInfraCo - eu-west-1, us-east-1), logging/monitoring (LogStream Inc. - us-east-1), analytics (ModelMetrics - us-central1), and storage fallback (ObjectStore LLC - eu-west-1 for EU-resident customers).
- SCCs: Redwood will execute controller→processor SCCs. We'll provide an executed copy after DocuSign completion. For customers who require an additional controller-controller agreement we can discuss but it's not our standard.
- Redlines: most of the edits look standard; we accept the majority but propose a small change to the objection window in section 4 from 15 to 10 business days for pilot customers (to keep timelines tight). If that's acceptable to GreenRetail, we will prepare the final packet.

DocuSign: we'll load the final DPA and send a DocuSign envelope. Expected timeline: final doc returned with agreed redlines by EOD Thursday → DocuSign out Friday morning → executed copy by Friday EOB if signatures returned quickly.

Please confirm if the 10-business-day objection window is acceptable and whether you want the EU residency option enabled for the pilot (there may be a small uptick in cost).

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
